Boxoban levels (2018)
https://github.com/google-deepmind/boxoban-levels

Authors: Arthur Guez, Mehdi Mirza, Karol Gregor, Rishabh Kabra,
Sebastien Racaniere, Theophane Weber, David Raposo, Adam Santoro,
Laurent Orseau, Tom Eccles, Greg Wayne, David Silver,
Timothy Lillicrap, and Victor Valdes.

This notice applies to the selected level data, not the MIT-licensed game engine.

Source:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google-deepmind/boxoban-levels/master/hard/000.txt
Retrieved: 2026-11-11
The original selected 10x10 records are preserved in levels.txt.
Puzzle IDs refer to the source's zero-based semicolon headers.

Adaptations in src/games/sokoban-levels.ts:
In-game level | Source ID | Crop bounds (x0,y0)-(x1,y1), inclusive | Transpose
1             | 6         | (0,1)-(7,9)                            | yes
2             | 47        | (0,0)-(6,9)                            | yes
3             | 7         | (0,0)-(9,7)                            | no
4             | 27        | (0,3)-(9,9)                            | no
5             | 17        | (0,0)-(9,5)                            | no

Only solid-wall margins were removed and two boards were transposed to fit
the existing 24px tiles in a 268x192 canvas. No playable cell, box, goal,
or player position was added or removed. The level array format was changed
from XSB text to TypeScript. Source IDs and source records are retained here.

Independent breadth-first push search confirms minimum push counts of
27, 20, 21, 20, and 19 respectively. The corresponding verified solutions
use 73, 75, 70, 71, and 73 walking inputs; these are not minimum move counts.
